post.caption: Elizabeth I's bracelet held a clock. A Tudor ledger lists an armlet with a clock in its clasp. The Earl of Leicester gave it to her for New Year. The armlet is lost, and its famous picture is a 1926 ad. In 1810 the Queen of Naples ordered a bracelet watch from Breguet. Breguet finished it in 1812 on a woven hair and gold strap. In 1868 Patek Philippe made a bracelet watch for a Hungarian countess. A lid set with rose cut diamonds covered the watch. By 1887 papers called gold bracelet watches a pretty and useful ornament. Most men held out until the First World War.
